description: This file contains a collection of partitioning functions for PySpark, including functions to partition data by years, months, days, hours, and by hash buckets. It also includes internal testing code.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Transforms a date or timestamp column to partition data by years.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Transforms a date or timestamp column to partition data by months.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Transforms a date or timestamp column to partition data by days.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Transforms a timestamp column to partition data by hours.

methods.name: bucket
methods.description: Partitions data into buckets based on a hash of the input column.
